expression.description: AT-URI of the expression whose annotation layers to list.

kind.description: Filter to layers of this annotation kind slug (e.g., token-tag, span, tree).

subkind.description: Filter to layers of this annotation subkind slug (e.g., pos, ner, dependency).

limit.description: Maximum number of annotation layers to return in one page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to resume from a previous page.
Opaque pagination cursor for the next page, absent when no further results remain.

records.description: The page of annotation layer records returned.

uri.description: AT-URI of this annotation layer record.

cid.description: CID of this annotation layer record at this revision.
